title: ATTACHED FORM NO. 1 — Application for Designation as a National Career Education Center
full_text:
ATTACHED FORM NO. 1 — Application for Designation as a National Career Education Center
[Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act]
Fields with a dark background shall not be completed by the applicant.

[OFFICE USE]
Receipt number: __________  Date received: __________  Processing period: 3 months

[APPLICANT]
Name of institution (organization): __________________
Business registration number or corporate registration number: __________________
Name of representative: __________________  Telephone number: __________________
Address/location: __________________________________________________________

APPLICATION
Pursuant to Article 15 (1) of the Career Education Act and Article 3 of its Enforcement Rule, I hereby apply for designation as a National Career Education Center as set forth above.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Applicant: __________________ (signature or seal)
To: Minister of Education

[DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY APPLICANT]
1. One copy of the articles of incorporation or internal regulations (only if the institution or organization seeking designation has such articles or regulations).
2. One copy of the statement of personnel and facilities.
3. One copy of the business plan for career education support services.
4. All other documents relating to the designation of a National Career Education Center.
Fee: None.

[MATTERS TO BE VERIFIED BY THE RESPONSIBLE PUBLIC OFFICIAL]
Certificate of registered corporate particulars (only where the applicant is a corporation), or certificate of business registration.

[CONSENT TO JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION]
I consent to the responsible public official verifying the above matters through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act in connection with the processing of this application.
* If the applicant does not give consent, the applicant shall submit the relevant documents directly.
Applicant: __________________ (signature or seal)

[PROCESSING PROCEDURE]
Application completed (Applicant) → Receipt (Ministry of Education) → Review (Ministry of Education) → Designation (Ministry of Education) → Notification (Ministry of Education).

Paper size: 210 mm × 297 mm; white paper (80 g/m²) or medium-weight paper (80 g/m²).
